approval_required_for: Any change to model semantics, decoder behavior, tensor shapes, token/order semantics, or task objective.
Any change to numeric policy, quantization/dequantization rules, golden outputs, comparison tolerance, or pass/fail thresholds.
Any architecture, pipeline, transfer-unit, stream-order, buffer, flow-control, liveness, memory-layout, memory-schedule, runtime-ABI, or board-memory-map change.
Any modification to the trusted template library, operator RTL templates, backend shell templates, or major generated-code template structure beyond bounded parameter/binding/glue repair.
Any free-form RTL rewrite or backend/app-shell patch not localized by real-tool evidence and accepted by repair_boundary_check and human_boundary_check.
Any promotion or downstream consumption of artifacts currently under SACG contamination barriers without checker-backed SACG trust reconciliation.

Any Vivado synthesis/implementation, AXI/DDR wrapping, runtime bitstream, board runtime, or deployment closure before operator-leaf and single-transformer-layer verification pass under a promoted Stage6 contract.
Any ambiguous backend/app-shell target selection when supplied board materials and real tool evidence do not uniquely identify the target.

bounded_repair_action_table.action: Emit bounded repair classification and Stage6 retry handoff.
conditions: Uses supplied trust-barrier and failure-classification evidence only.
Passes repair_boundary_check, human_boundary_check, causal_repair_context_check, and sacg_static_check.

bounded_repair_action_table.action: Regenerate/refine Stage6 verification plan, artifact contract, LLM action audit, and gate selector contract.
conditions: Prior Stage6 artifacts are consumed only as rejected planning evidence.
No model, numeric, architecture, memory, runtime, template-library, or board assumption changes.

bounded_repair_action_table.action: Reconcile SACG retry requests and contamination barriers after Stage6 retry artifacts pass all Stage6 acceptance checks.
conditions: Checker evidence is attached to SACG updates.
No barrier is silently ignored or manually overridden.

bounded_repair_action_table.action: Rerun Stage7 operator-leaf checks under clean Stage6 contract.
conditions: Uses promoted Stage6 verification_artifact_contract and llm_action_audit.
Prior Stage7 results remain rejected planning evidence only.

bounded_repair_action_table.action: If clean operator-leaf rerun fails, localize failure and apply only bounded template-parameter/generated-glue repair.
conditions: Earliest causal boundary is identified by failure_localization_check and targeted_replay_check.
No trusted-template, architecture, numeric, model, memory, runtime, or board assumption change.

bounded_repair_action_table.action: Any fix requiring trusted-template edits, free-form RTL, model/numeric/shape/pipeline/memory/runtime changes, or backend deployment assumptions.
conditions: Must record explicit human approval before execution.

bounded_repair_action_table.action: Board/app-shell target discovery, AXI/DDR integration, Vivado implementation, runtime bitstream, or board runtime before operator-leaf and single-layer verification closure.
conditions: May resume only after lower-layer verification is promoted and backend evidence is unambiguous or approved.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep Stage8 repair artifacts classified as planning/debug evidence only; do not hand off to Stage6 or Stage7 until the boundary classification passes.
executable_actions.rationale: Convert root-cause, artifact-trust, and evidence-gap findings into a checker-grounded action table without implementing repairs or overriding human approval boundaries.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep retry_request.0001 open, keep Stage7 and backend blocked, and return the failed contract evidence to Stage8 for boundary classification; do not execute real tools from the rejected contract.
executable_actions.rationale: The current causal blocker is an incomplete/rejected Stage6 verification gate DAG and tool-protocol contract. Refinement is auto-allowed only for verification planning artifacts and must not change model semantics, numeric policy, architecture, pipeline, memory layout, runtime ABI, trusted templates, or board assumptions.

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not consume candidate Stage6 artifacts downstream; keep all Stage6, Stage7, and Stage8 contamination barriers active and request a Stage6 retry fix.
executable_actions.rationale: Contamination barriers and retry requests may be closed or superseded only after candidate Stage6 artifacts pass their required checks; rejected artifacts remain planning/debug evidence until SACG records a clean promotion path.

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not promote the operator leaf and do not proceed to single-layer or board work; route real-tool evidence to contract-guided localization and bounded repair.
executable_actions.rationale: The three-layer repair loop requires a clean operator/leaf rerun after Stage6 contract promotion. Prior Stage7 evidence is contaminated and can guide planning only, not promotion.

executable_actions.on_failure: Stop repair, keep the failed layer blocked, and request human approval if the required fix exceeds trusted-template or generated-glue boundaries.
executable_actions.rationale: If the clean operator-leaf rerun shows a real liveness, value, order, or protocol failure, the earliest causal boundary must be localized before any code repair. Only generated-artifact binding/glue fixes within trusted templates are auto-allowed; template-library, architecture, numeric, memory, runtime, or model changes require approval.

executable_actions.on_failure: Localize the failing single-layer boundary and return to Stage8 bounded repair; do not proceed to board, AXI/DDR, Vivado, runtime ABI, bitstream, or board runtime.
executable_actions.rationale: Single-transformer-layer closure is the next permitted layer only after operator-leaf promotion under the clean Stage6 contract. This checks connected-layer data order, transfer counts, numeric comparisons, and liveness before any board work.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep all backend, app-shell, Vivado, runtime-bitstream, and board-runtime actions blocked until lower-layer verification is clean or explicit human approval is recorded for a bounded recovery action.
executable_actions.rationale: Backend/app-shell, AXI/DDR, Vivado, runtime, bitstream, and board deployment actions are later-stage work and are unsafe while Stage6/Stage7 trust barriers remain active. Ambiguous board target discovery must use cited real evidence or explicit approval instead of guessed names.

forbidden_or_deferred_actions: Do not consume artifact.stage6.verification_plan, artifact.stage6.verification_artifact_contract, artifact.stage6.llm_action_audit, Stage7 artifacts, or Stage8 repair artifacts as validated design inputs while their active contamination barriers remain unresolved.
Do not claim hardware correctness or verification pass from not_run real tools, compact diagnostics, or rejected-transition evidence.
Do not modify golden outputs, comparison tolerances, or numeric policy to convert a failure into a pass.
Do not perform free-form RTL rewrites, backend shell patches, or board-specific integration changes without causal localization and required approval.
Do not skip from operator-leaf evidence to board/AXI/DDR/Vivado/runtime work; single-transformer-layer closure must occur first after leaf promotion.
Do not guess app-shell target names or board integration points when evidence is ambiguous.
human_approval_required_items: Changing trusted templates or introducing free-form RTL/backend code.
Changing model semantics, tensor shapes, data order, numeric policy, golden outputs, tolerances, architecture, pipeline, memory layout, runtime ABI, or deployment assumptions.
Overriding SACG contamination barriers or retry requests without checker-backed promotion evidence.
Proceeding to board/app-shell/Vivado/runtime closure with active Stage6 or Stage7 verification blockers.
Selecting ambiguous backend/app-shell targets without cited real tool evidence.
observations: The supplied state_summary.sacg_memory_truth records 23 active contamination barriers and 4 open retry requests; there are no open backtrack requests. These are current blockers for downstream consumption and must be handled explicitly.

Current blockers are dominated by rejected/unpromoted Stage6 verification artifacts: artifact.stage6.verification_plan, artifact.stage6.verification_artifact_contract, and artifact.stage6.llm_action_audit are contaminated and cannot be consumed as validated Stage7 inputs.

Stage7 artifacts, including verification_result, real_tool_results, debug_closure, and operator_leaf_promotion_certificate, are also contaminated. Any operator-leaf evidence reported as passing is planning/debug evidence only until Stage6 is repaired and Stage7 is rerun under a clean contract.

Stage8 repair_plan and repair_execution_report are contaminated as downstream design evidence. They may be used only as repair-planning evidence and must not be treated as completed design repair or verification closure.

The visible failed invariants are verification_plan_static_check and verification_agent_decision_check. The supplied evidence supports a verification-contract/trust-boundary root cause, not a proven free-form RTL, backend, board, or runtime implementation defect.

The candidate_stage_artifact indicates the case adapter is ready and that contract-guided debug and hierarchical repair-loop diagnostics exist. Because only compact keys are visible, omitted diagnostic details are handoff items rather than independent missing-field blockers.
The candidate note correctly classifies not_run real tools as evidence gaps, not automatic repair failures. Missing real-tool evidence cannot be converted into a pass.

The required hardware debug order remains operator/leaf modules first, then the connected single-transformer-layer kernel, then board-accurate AXI/DDR wrapped system. A failed layer must be localized and repaired before promotion to the next layer.

Automatic repair authority is limited to contract/planning refinements, SACG trust reconciliation based on checker evidence, and template-bound generated-artifact repair after causal localization. Human approval is required for model, shape, numeric policy, pipeline, memory layout, runtime ABI, template-library, or deployment-assumption changes.
proposed_actions: Generate the bounded repair classification, approval list, forbidden/deferred action list, and Stage6 retry handoff card under repair_boundary_check, human_boundary_check, causal_repair_context_check, and sacg_static_check.
Retry Stage6 verification-artifact generation/refinement using Stage5 design artifacts, tool_protocols, and case_adapter; treat prior Stage6 artifacts only as rejected planning evidence.

After Stage6 candidate artifacts pass all static, protocol, hierarchy, artifact-contract, LLM-audit, and SACG-reference checks, reconcile SACG contamination barriers and retry requests before any downstream verification rerun.
Rerun Stage7 operator-leaf real-tool checks under the clean promoted Stage6 contract; do not reuse contaminated Stage7 pass claims as promotion evidence.
If the operator-leaf rerun fails, localize the earliest causal boundary with trace replay and perform only template-bound repair inside the trusted library and human boundary policy.
After operator-leaf promotion, run single-transformer-layer functional/golden/data-order/transfer/liveness closure before any board or backend action.
Keep board/app-shell target discovery, AXI/DDR integration, Vivado synthesis/implementation, runtime ABI, bitstream, and board runtime actions deferred until the lower verification layers are clean.
risks: Using contaminated Stage6 artifacts as validated inputs could produce a false Stage7 pass and violate SACG trust barriers.

Rerunning Stage7 without a clean verification artifact contract risks cross-layer inconsistency across model semantics, tensor shapes, numeric policy, data order, transfer counts, memory layout, runtime ABI, implementation manifests, and board assumptions.
Free-form RTL or backend changes would exceed the repair boundary and could bypass trusted templates and causal localization.
Proceeding directly to Vivado, AXI/DDR, runtime bitstream, or board execution before operator-leaf and single-transformer-layer closure would skip the required three-layer repair loop.
Treating not_run real tools or compact diagnostic summaries as hardware correctness evidence would violate the verification plan and tool-evidence constraints.
Changing golden outputs, tolerances, numeric comparison policy, or model semantics to make checks pass would invalidate verification evidence.
Ambiguous backend/app-shell target discovery must not be resolved by guessing target names; it requires real Vivado/board evidence or bounded human approval.

retry_request.0002: Stage7 verification result did not pass all selected gates
retry_request.0003: bounded repair actions must be completed before verification promotion
retry_request.0004: Stage7 verification result did not pass all selected gates
stage6_retry_handoff_card.failure_next_step: Keep Stage7 and backend blocked; return failed Stage6 contract evidence to Stage8 bounded repair classification.
stage6_retry_handoff_card.success_next_step: Rerun Stage7 operator-leaf real-tool closure under the clean promoted Stage6 contract.

output.summary: Repair classification is bounded to verification-contract/trust repair. The current promotable path is: refine/promote Stage6 verification artifacts, reconcile SACG trust barriers, rerun Stage7 operator-leaf evidence under the clean contract, then run single-transformer-layer closure before any board/AXI/DDR/Vivado/runtime work. No hardware pass, RTL fix, backend closure, golden-output change, or tolerance relaxation is supported by the supplied evidence.
